research_question: Can an objective-aligned, causal policy-health gate preserve the historical Sharpe benefit of a fixed stock-risk overlay while abstaining when that overlay has stopped improving the crypto carrier?

parent_evidence.allowed_learning: static stock-risk direction supported; forecast-MSE health rejected; no RiskCast parameter may be tuned here
parent_evidence.forbidden: no reuse of post-2022 diagnostics to set thresholds or windows

fixed_stock_overlay.source: formula-identical static_median policy from frozen RiskCast experiment

policy_health.hypothetical_return_definition: sum of previous-day policy weights times current crypto close-to-close return
policy_health.internal_cost_model: none; cost-free realized policy utility proxy only
policy_health.dual_gate: enable fixed stock overlay only when its fast and slow trailing Sharpe both exceed base fast and slow trailing Sharpe; otherwise use base

modes.fast_only: enable overlay when 126d overlay Sharpe exceeds 126d base Sharpe
modes.slow_only: enable overlay when 252d overlay Sharpe exceeds 252d base Sharpe
modes.inverted_dual: enable overlay only when its fast and slow Sharpe are both below base; destructive control
modes.dual: candidate: both fast and slow overlay Sharpe must exceed base

falsifiers: dual must beat base on 2016-2022 selection Sharpe at 4% ATR cost
dual must beat inverted_dual to support policy-health direction
dual should beat always_static for the gate to earn complexity
dual should not depend on a single horizon: if fast_only or slow_only clearly dominates, dual confirmation has not earned complexity
no post-result threshold, window, risk-floor, expert-set, or rebalance-frequency rescue

constraints.data: Quantiacs-provided crypto and historical constituent stock data only
